retrievalProfile.description: A dark, high-gloss 3D render featuring stylized vinyl figures and metallic balloon-style typography against a black void.
excludeWhen: bright or colorful backgrounds are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A minimalist 3D scene featuring two back-to-back figures in high-shine black streetwear, positioned under floating chrome balloon-style lettering, all set within a dark, reflective studio environment.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical stack of floating chrome text above centered figures
High-contrast highlights on dark glossy surfaces
Small pops of saturated color against a monochromatic base
coreInvariants: High-gloss specular reflections on all surfaces
Metallic chrome material for floating elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two figures centered in the lower half, scaled to occupy roughly one-third of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright chrome lettering at the top center acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bright chrome text, move down to the figures, and settle on the small colored accents in their hands.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space surrounding the central subjects to emphasize the 3D forms.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant magenta and off-white (props and footwear)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast between the black void and the metallic reflections.

characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'M' features a deep central dip with rounded peaks
The '2' has a thick, tubular structure with a flat base
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single 3D style for all text elements to maintain material consistency.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the high-reflectivity and rounded forms

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 3D render of two back-to-back figures in glossy black hooded streetwear standing on a dark reflective floor in a black void, holding small magenta bottles.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom 3D chrome balloon lettering floating in the upper center, ensuring the reflections match the scene lighting.

verificationChecks: Check for high-gloss specular highlights on the figures
Ensure the text has a convincing 3D metallic chrome texture
Verify the background is a deep, clean black void
Confirm the figures are positioned back-to-back

postGenerationChecks: Is the chrome text the brightest element?
Are the figures' surfaces highly reflective?
Is the composition centered and balanced?
recipe.reuseFormula: 3D Glossy Figures + Chrome Balloon Type + Black Void Studio
